en.title: Minimum Flips to Match Expected Binary Values in a Tree
en.description:
You are given an undirected tree rooted at 0. Performing an operation on node u flips every node in u's subtree whose index has the same parity as u. Find the minimum number of operations to turn initial entirely into expected.

The standard input/output format and supplementary constraints stated by this site belong to the definition of the online version and do not pose as the source's original constraints.
en.input: Input N (1..100000), N−1 0-based edges, and two binary arrays initial and expected.
en.output: Output the minimum number of operations.
en.explanation: Traverse from the root. Track the parity of flips that ancestor operations apply to even-indexed and odd-indexed nodes separately; if the current node still does not match, an operation must be performed here.
